2 दा॑ m. giver;
 often —˚ giving, granting.

3 दा दा॑ति द्य॑ति pp. दिन॑ & दित cut, mow. —अव
cut off, divide (esp. the sacrif. cake). निस् distribute, among (2
acc.). समव cut in pieces and collect them. आ, वि & सम् cut up,
bruise, crush. — Cf. अ॑वत्त, सम॑वत्त.

4 दा द्य॑ति pp. दित (only —˚) bind. —आ & नि tie,
fetter. वि loosen. सम् bind together, fasten, tie. — Cf. नि॑दित,
स॑दित.
5 दा pp. दात (—˚) clean, purify. — Cf. अवदात.
